notes: Both occurrences of מִקְנֶה are aligned independently: s002 to the discontinuous 'a ... of cattle' and s028 to 'for cattle' on the rectum (rule 19).

The four-word Hebrew predicate מִקְנֶה רַב ... עָצוּם מְאֹד is distributed word for word: רַב 'great', מְאֹד 'very', עָצוּם 'multitude'. The competing reading takes 'multitude' as a generic supplied for מִקְנֶה under rule 31, but that leaves עָצוּם with no English at all; the accepted note already records this.
s014 'and when' and s023 'that' are each a connective written for its own waw (rules 14, 55); הָיָה carries the 'had', so both possessive לְs are silenced (rules 43, 40).
